rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: a projected slide whose referent nobody can resolve. Closest: L70 'the stance you kept' (chunk 4) resolves to the three role stances named in chunk 3 bullets L58-60; L72 'the tree file' is a session artifact of the Phase 2 merge (session-artifacts carve-out); L39 added sentence 'If one comes back fast with almost nothing, tell it there is more here and send it back' - 'one'/'it' resolve to the subagent named in the preceding sentence 'Three subagents fanning out'.

Harm: a callback whose target depends on deck position. L7 'Pick the outcome' and L76 'Choose the bet' name sibling exercises by title; grep -nE 'opening|earlier|previous|last lecture' over body L1-77 -> 0 hits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: a pointer to a beat that no longer exists. L7 'the outcome you agreed in Pick the outcome' (apt101-pick-the-outcome exercise exists, same module arc); L37 'back in your first session' (the evidence-gathering session of the prior exercise); L76 'Choose the bet' is a forward title pointer to a sibling exercise. No 'the X you caught' beat reference.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: a demo beat with no scene under a muted read. No guess-before-reveal beat (grep -niE 'guess|predict' body -> 0). Closest: L39 'Three subagents fanning out at once.' is a verbless fragment, but it narrates a run the student started one line earlier and is followed by verbed steers ('stop it, steer narrower', and the new 'tell it there is more here'); not a trainer-only scene. See suggestion.

Harm: a slide saying nothing standalone. Smallest chunk 1 (L11-19, ~85 words): three paragraphs each with a task claim (no talking/no Claude, write opportunities, put down the one only you would think of). Every chunk carries an instruction.

Harm: header contradicted by its slide. Closest: chunk 3 'Read the evidence three ways' (L33) vs L37-60: three stance subagents and three role reads = three ways; chunk 2 'Merge with every name kept' vs L25-31 merge keeping names. True.

Harm: a tic that becomes the whole slide. grep -nE 'Not [A-Za-z]+\. Not' -> 0. No anaphora triple (L25 roles each carry a distinct verb); no superlatives; no number+retraction; no abstraction stack; no empty-leg verb triplet (closest L39 'stop it, steer narrower, then say continue' - three concrete actions). New L39 sentence is one declarative with a concrete move.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: maintainer vocabulary on a wall. grep -niE 'compendium|forcing function|surface|firing|beat|mood' over body L1-77 -> 0 hits. 'stance'/'subagents' are the reused A101 prompt's ordinary words.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget - bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: bold sprayed so nothing is a handle. Body bold: L3 'Time:', L5 'What you do:' (field labels), L58-60 three role:stance leads. Closest: L60 '**Team lead: the planner working back from the outcome.**' is 9 words, past the ~5-word cap; L58 '**Product owner: the assumption tester.**' is 5. The three form a parallel set of named stances (checklist-item names) with the question after each, so judged PASS as a set, not a budget breach; see suggestion.
